Interface Room

public interface Room
A coinflip room: made by one player with a stake, joined by others, then flipped once. Rooms are read-only through this interface; Coinflip changes them (through CoinflipAPI) and tells listeners.

Provably fair: each room gets a secret random seed when it is made. hash() (the SHA-256 of the seed, as lower-case hex) is shown from the start; seed() is revealed after the flip. The roll is the first 13 hex digits of SHA-256(seed + ":" + id) divided by 16^13, a number from 0 to 1, and the room's mode turns it into a winner (the coins mode: under 0.5 is heads).
